title: Rem + Abrams: Scourge cast by Rem while napping on Abrams
question: Does Rem's Scourge, cast while napping on Abrams, last 13.5s and out-damage Abrams' own Scourge, and do two Scourges refresh rather than stack?
hypothesis: H-B2-2.1: Scourge self-cast by Rem during Tag Along lands on Abrams and lasts 13.5s (+35%, Tag Along T2), +-0.5s. H-B2-2.2: a second Scourge on Abrams refreshes (aura damage per second unchanged, <5% change) rather than stacking. H-B2-2.3: Rem's Scourge total damage on 3 bots per cast is >=25% higher than Abrams' own at the same souls (13.5s x Rem napping spirit ~190 vs 10s x Abrams ~168). H-B2-2.4: Divine Barrier self-cast while napping gives Abrams 810 barrier (+-5%).

arms.name: rem_scourge_napping
arms.notes: rem_duo_abrams naps on abrams_duo_rem, self-casts Scourge

setup.position: Abrams standing among 3 bots (within 6m), Rem napping on him

controls: Cooldowns, HP and debuffs reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Abrams walks into the 3 bots and does nothing else
Arm A: Abrams casts Scourge on himself. Arm B: Rem Tag Alongs onto Abrams and self-casts Scourge within 1s. Arm C: both cast, 1s apart
Time the Scourge buff on Abrams, sum Scourge damage on the 3 bots until it ends
Arm B also: Rem self-casts Divine Barrier while napping, read the barrier bar

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if rem_scourge_napping beats abrams_own_scourge by >=25% with non-overlapping ranges; REFUTES if Rem's is not higher; else INCONCLUSIVE. If double_scourge deals >=40% more per second than one, two copies stack and Abrams keeps his own (revert the Abrams swap).
